description: Land Title Settlement Department - Jayashripura, Thalawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110290 (22/0829)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding the determination of titles for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. The document includes detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, extents, owners, and other land-specific information. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
